function: Beamspace channel estimation: reconstructs the full-dimensional sparse channel from few pilot measurements with an unfolded trimmed-ridge regression network (p. 1, 6).
system: TDD mmWave (no carrier given) massive MIMO uplink, BS lens array with 256 antennas, 16 RF chains, one-bit phase shifters; 16 single-antenna users; no RIS (p. 2, 8).
method: Deep unfolding of iterative trimmed-ridge regression into a 30-layer network with trainable matrices and step sizes; supervised MSE training; ensemble of four top-K models (p. 7-9).
data_channel: Own Saleh-Valenzuela simulation, DFT to beamspace, normalized; 80,000 training, 2,000 validation and 2,000 test samples (p. 9).
test_conditions: Train and test on the same simulator; test SNR swept; pilot length M=128 by default, M=64 reported separately (p. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: OMP, AMP, own ITRR; learned: GM-LAMP, CNN-based estimator, SBL-CE-Net (p. 9-11).
metrics: NMSE, ratio of accurately reconstructed channels, downlink sum rate with zero-forcing precoding, training time (p. 9-12).
complexity: UTRR forward pass O(LMN^2) vs ITRR O(TMN^2); trainable parameters L(2MN+2); training time 255 vs 548 min (p. 7, 10, 12).
q1_support: p. 9: "we first use the Saleh-Valenzuela channel model in (2) to generate the spatial channel samples"; custom simulator, no 3GPP model or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 9: "The training dataset, validation dataset and testing dataset contain 80, 000, 2, 000, and 2, 000 beamspace channels and measurements"; all from one generator, only an SNR sweep and a separate M=64 result.
q3_support: p. 9: "two iterative algorithms including the OMP [18] and AMP [25] algorithms, and three deep-learning methods including a model-based network GM-LAMP [45]"; compared on NMSE (Fig. 8, p. 10; Fig. 9, p. 11).
q4_support: p. 12: "The forward-pass computational complexity of a UTRR network is O(LM N 2 )"
q5_support: p. 9: "we first use the Saleh-Valenzuela channel model in (2) to generate the spatial channel samples"; data come from the authors' simulator, and the paper gives no link to code or data.
notes: Deep unfolding with trained parameters counts as learned; area 2 (beamspace channel estimation). q2 is 0: the trainable matrices have size Mx2N (p. 6), so M=64 results (Table II, p. 11) are separate models, and the paper never tests a trained model in a different scenario, array, user count or pilot length. q3 is 1: OMP and AMP are non-learned, GM-LAMP, CNN and SBL-CE-Net are earlier learned methods, all compared on NMSE. The PDF is the arXiv preprint (arXiv:2408.02934v1), which does not print the DOI, so the DOI match rests on the file name.
